- If ScaleNet needs an earlier start, we can attempt to accelerate to June with an accelerated provisioning fee and an earlier acceptance window.

Other notes
- Billing: monthly in arrears based on committed units with overage at a discounted rate.
- Termination: standard termination on breach; early termination for convenience available with a remaining-commitment buyout (outlined in SOW).

Next steps: Jordan — if you can confirm target term (12/24/36) and preferred start date, I’ll route to legal and ops for a redline-ready SOW.
